description: Binding rules for any tool that writes recipes into this vault
claude_code_rules: Apply tags per the tag rows and their rules. Never apply tags marked DO NOT APPLY. Derive region tags automatically from cuisine tags. Do not use em dashes in any file. File recipes into an existing cuisine subfolder only; never create new folders automatically. Never write into the private folder. Recipe names are grammatically complete and title case; proper-named and foreign-named dishes carry a parenthetical descriptor.

description: YAML frontmatter block required on every recipe
claude_code_rules: Every recipe file begins with a YAML block delimited by --- lines. Required fields in order: tags, prep_time, cook_time, total_time, yield, difficulty.

Format: tags: [tag1, tag2, tag3]. Include all applicable cuisine, region, sub-region, classification, course, drink_placement, staples_use, staples_type, dietary, method, occasion, effort, lifestyle, character, and anchor tags. Exclude mastery and provenance tags.
Format: N mins or N hours. Must match the time stated in the recipe body. Omit if the body states no prep time.
Format: N mins, N hours, or a range such as 2 to 12 hours. Must match the time stated in the recipe body, including ranges. Omit if the body states no cook time.
Must match the recipe body. Ranges permitted. Include or exclude marinating and resting time consistent with the recipe body. Omit if not stated.
Format: N servings, or a unit appropriate to the recipe such as 50 poppers or 2 wraps. Omit if not stated.
Permitted values: easy, medium, hard.

Filenames and H1 titles are title case with spaces. Names are grammatically complete. Proper-named and foreign-named dishes carry a parenthetical descriptor, for example Miang Kham (Thai Leaf-Wrapped Bites) or Gochujang Sauce (Korean Chili Sauce).

The filename carries the title; no H1 in the body. After frontmatter: an optional italic description line written only by the vault owner (tools never generate one), a Source line with the URL when imported from a URL, then sections: Ingredients, Instructions (numbered steps), Notes. The At a Glance process grid is inserted by tooling; never write an At a Glance section or summary table yourself. Never repeat frontmatter values (times, yield, servings) as bold body lines.
No em dashes anywhere in any file. Use commas, colons, periods, or parentheses instead.
